description: Godot scene: show the node tree (names, types, scripts, instanced sub-scenes) of a scene. Use depth/max_nodes to keep large scenes small; start from a subtree with root.

root.description: Start from this node path instead of the scene root. An instanced sub-scene lists its own (hidden_children) nodes.

scene.description: Scene file, e.g. "res://main.tscn". Defaults to the scene open in the editor; required when the editor is closed.

name: godot_scene_tree
title: Scene tree
